newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-DORTMUND BOUNCE BACK WITH VICTORY TO GO TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DORTMUND BOUNCE BACK WITH VICTORY TO GO TOP.

text.p: Champions Borussia Dortmund bounced back from two consecutive defeats with a 1-0 victory at struggling St Pauli to go top of the German first division on Thursday.

A 69th minute goal from German international midfielder Andy Moeller helped the European Cup semifinalists get back to winning ways after suffering their first home defeat for more than a year last weekend.
Dortmund lead on goal difference from Bayern Munich who meet Werder Bremen at home on Saturday.
Injury-hit VfB Stuttgart missed an opportunity to take the initiative in the tight championship race when they were held to a 1-1 draw at home by 1860 Munich
Stuttgart had a disappointing night, letting in an own goal in the seventh minute and seeing their Brazilian striker Giovane Elber sent off in the second half for a second bookable offence.
Stuttgart are third one point behind the leading pair. But fourth-placed Bayer Leverkusen, a further point behind, have a chance to improve their position when they play hosts to Schalke on Saturday.
